messages:
Maria (CS): Need a one-pager for customers: cache priming, batching knobs, streaming fallback, 72h playbook. Short and prescriptive.
Sam (SRE): I'll draft. Audience: eng leads and CS techs?
Maria (CS): Yes. Include one-line copy-paste snippets and clear escalation.
Sam (SRE): Draft:
--- START ---
1) Before traffic: pin model, enable cache priming for top 15 intents (ttl 120s), warm at 1x steady QPS for 10m.
2) Batching: target 4-12 for prompts; 1-3 for low-latency chat; max_wait 20-80ms; if many singletons +10ms coalesce.
3) Streaming: use for progressive UX; if stall >500ms send header x-rw-fallback:true and retry non-streaming.
4) Quick cache write example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/cache/write -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"key":"intent:hello","value":"Hi","ttl":120}'
5) 72h playbook: Day0 observe; Day1 tune batch & ttl; Day2 cost review + rollback plan.
6) Alerts: p99 >1.5x SLO for 10m, cache-hit <60% for 30m, error rate >0.5%.
7) Escalation: support@redwood.ai -> #customer-success -> SRE on-call (include trace id).
--- END ---
Jordan (PM): Nice. Add a one-line exec summary: 'Reduces latency and cost while keeping predictable UX during surges.'
Kyle (Support): Add link to shared dashboard when finalized.
Sam (SRE): Will update with Grafana JSON and SDK snippets. Planning to hand to Maria for PDF.
deploy-bot: Draft uploaded to staging: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/cs/surge-play (preview)
Maria (CS): Thanks team, tagging this for the onboarding pack.
